basic_details.job_title: RMLAU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University (RMLAU) has published a notification for 1 project-based Junior Research Assistant vacancy in 2026. Applicants must hold an M.Sc. in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Science or allied subjects, and be not more than 28 years of age. The position carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 28,000 per month for a period of approximately 15 months only. Eligible candidates can send the filled up application along with all required documents by email up to 21 October 2026, or attend the walk-in-interview with original documents and one set of photocopies.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Required Junior Research Assistant (JRA) Graduation with first division, and must be a first division holder of M.Sc. in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Science or allied subjects. Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.

how_to_apply: Download or obtain the attached application form from the official notification.
Fill up the application form completely with all required details.
Gather copies of all required academic records, experience certificates, and publications.
Send the filled-up application along with all required documents by email to [email protected] (Prof. Neelam Pathak) or [email protected] (Dr. Manikant Tripathi) on or before 21-10-2026.
Bring original documents along with one set of photocopies when attending the walk-in-interview.
important_instructions: The appointment of JRA in the project will be full time and purely on temporary basis for the remaining period or on satisfactory performance. The selected candidate can be terminated at any time without prior information with one month salary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must bring original documents along with one set of photocopies during the interview.
